title: Ex 1.1 #4 · {x ∈ ℕ : −2 < x ≤ 7}
prompt: Write the set $\{x \in \mathbb{N} : -2 < x \le 7\}$ by listing its elements between braces.
answer_format: A set listed between braces, like {1, 2, 3} (∅ for the empty set). Steps are optional.
hints: Here x ranges over ℕ, not ℤ. What is the smallest natural number in Book of Proof?
Then keep every natural number up to the upper bound, checking whether 7 itself is allowed.
solution: In Book of Proof ℕ = {1, 2, 3, …}, so the lower bound −2 < x adds nothing. The upper bound x ≤ 7 includes 7.
